label: copy phase: outputting, or about to output, m or x
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.7% of mass), and never on the first occurrence of a token. It is strongest on copy steps whose output is m (85% of those steps are active) or x (78%), and it also fires on the step just before an m or x is output (next_out m: 48%). The largest activations come on the output step immediately before an m m / x m run, with continued firing across the run. Outputs i, d and t give weaker lift. On top of this there is a diffuse low-magnitude background over many other copy steps, mostly in the middle of recall (recall_idx 2-4). The predicate does not capture that background, and it holds most of the missed mass. Almost silent during the original phase and on the delimiter step. Dev: precision 0.78, recall 0.49, F1 0.60, mass recall 0.62. It covers 96% of top-quartile activations.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: m, x, i, d, t, w; least: f, j, c, 2) and the next token to output (most: m, x, i, w, s, 0; least: k, j, 2, c); timing cues that raise it most: phase=2, recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4.
